title: Breast Lift Without Implants: Who It Suits and Results
meta_description: A breast lift without implants raises and reshapes your own tissue but doesn't add size. Who it suits, what results look like, and what it can't do.
excerpt: A breast lift without implants raises and reshapes your own tissue but doesn't add size. Here is what it can and can't do, who it suits, when you may want volume too, what results look like over time and how long they last.
quick_answer:
Can you get a breast lift without implants?

Yes. A lift alone raises and reshapes your own tissue by removing stretched skin and moving the nipple higher. The American Society of Plastic Surgeons says it doesn't significantly change your size or round out the upper breast. Cleveland Clinic says results should last for several years, though aging, pregnancy and weight changes still affect them.

sources.title: Breast Lift Surgery (Mastopexy)
quotes: If you are happy with your breast size, but not the way your breasts look, you may benefit from a breast lift.
If you have too little or too much breast volume, your surgeon may recommend a breast augmentation or breast reduction in addition to your breast lift.
Your breast lift results might slowly diminish over time because of gravity and aging.

If you have large and heavy breasts, you can get a breast lift, but the results may not be as long-lasting as a breast lift performed on smaller breasts as the weight of larger breasts works against surgical changes.
If you plan to have children, you may want to postpone your breast lift surgery. Pregnancy may stretch the breasts and reduce their volume, compromising your surgery results.

sources.title: Breast Lift
quotes: Breast lifts are often combined with breast augmentation to add volume to the upper portion of the breast.
Patients with smaller breasts and minimal sagging may be candidates for a mastopexy procedure that involves smaller incisions than a standard breast lift requires.
Breast lift surgery incisions do leave scars, but they will fade with time (with maximum fading occurring in around one year).

You may experience some loss of sensation in your nipples and breasts following mastopexy surgery, with sensation gradually returning over a few weeks or months. However, some patients experience numbness for up to a year. On rare occasions, loss of sensation can be permanent.
Breast lift surgery is performed in an outpatient setting, usually under general anesthesia and typically takes two-and-a-half to three hours.
